playbooks.title: Automatic follow-ups
playbooks.intro: The only automations that reach a client without you clicking. Nothing goes out until you arm it.
playbooks.guardrails: Guardrails, always on: a reply stops everything for good · one follow-up per target, never an escalation · opt-out checked on every send · Monday to Friday only, between {{start}}:00 and {{end}}:00 · at most {{cap}} sends a day for the whole workspace.
playbooks.silenceLabel: Days of silence before following up
playbooks.loadError: Could not read the follow-up settings. Nothing was changed.

submission_no_reply.title: CV sent, no reply
submission_no_reply.description: Follows up once when a submitted profile gets no answer.

mission_renewal.title: Mission coming to an end
mission_renewal.description: Follows up once when a mission ends and no renewal is open.

proposal_no_reply.title: Proposal with no reply
proposal_no_reply.description: Follows up once when a commercial proposal gets no answer.

toast.armed: Follow-up armed. It will go out during working hours, once per target.
toast.stopped: Follow-up turned off. No more automatic sends for this rule.

dryRun.noSend: Simulation: nothing is sent, nothing is recorded.
dryRun.empty: No target to examine for this playbook.
dryRun.error: Simulation unavailable — we cannot conclude that nothing would go out.

interventions.title: Needs a decision
interventions.intro: What the product cannot decide on its own and is waiting on a person.
interventions.empty: Nothing needs your arbitration right now.
interventions.loadError: Could not read the queue. This is not "nothing to handle".
interventions.reasonPrompt: Say what was done. An item closed without a reason cannot be read back three weeks later.

consequences.submission_stalled: Without a follow-up, the profile drops off the client shortlist and the seat is taken.
consequences.renewal_at_risk: Without a decision, the mission stops at its term and the consultant goes back on the bench.
consequences.invoicing_blocked: While the blocker stands, the month is not invoiced and cash-in slips by as much.
consequences.account_untouched: Without renewed contact, the account goes cold and everything has to be reopened.
consequences.rep_inactive: Without a check-in, their portfolio moves on with nobody knowing.
consequences.credits_exhausted: Allowance reached: analyses and enrichments are blocked for your whole workspace.
consequences.account_no_next_action: With no next action set, nobody will pick this account up — it surfaces in no queue.
consequences.project_no_decision: While the need stays still, it takes up a slot in the pipeline without contributing to it.
consequences.need_without_shortlist: With no profile submitted, the client will decide on other firms’ proposals.
consequences.timesheet_missing: Without a signed timesheet, the month cannot be invoiced, whatever work was actually done.
consequences.payment_overdue: Every extra day late lowers the odds of collecting without formal proceedings.
consequences.mission_without_end_date: With no end date, the mission counts in neither the forecast nor the capacity figure.
consequences.staffing_collision: Until someone decides, both needs are counting on the same consultant — one of the two clients will be let down.

causes.submission_stalled: A profile was submitted to the client and has had no reply for too long.
causes.renewal_at_risk: No renewal has been opened before the mission's end date.
causes.invoicing_blocked: A worked month has not yet been cleared for invoicing.
causes.account_untouched: No action has been logged on this account for too long.
causes.rep_inactive: The rep has not validated any action for too long.
causes.credits_exhausted: The workspace has used the product heavily this month.
causes.account_no_next_action: No next action has been planned on this tracked account.
causes.project_no_decision: The need has not moved for longer than its stage's typical duration.
causes.need_without_shortlist: No profile has been submitted on this open need for too long.
causes.timesheet_missing: The expected timesheet still has not arrived despite the reminders sent.
causes.payment_overdue: The invoice's payment due date has passed with no cash-in.
causes.mission_without_end_date: The mission has never been given an end date.
causes.staffing_collision: The same consultant is submitted, open, on two distinct needs.

approvals.rejected: Follow-up cancelled. It will not be offered again.
approvals.failed: The follow-up did not go out.
